course.title: English B1 → B2: 16-Week Preparation
course.subtitle: 16-week blended B2 preparation course (~63 hours full, 55 hours minimum) with 15-minute daily app sessions, Saturday writing (30 min), two weekly live lessons, and 4 checkpoints.
course.description: A structured 16-week B1 to B2 preparation pathway built on output before progress. Every week follows a 7-day rotation — vocabulary, grammar (1 main point + 1 light point), listening, reading, required Friday speaking, required Saturday writing, and Sunday review — paired with two weekly live lessons (60 and 55 minutes) and four milestone checkpoints. This course provides focused B2 preparation rather than a guarantee of a B2 exam result.
course.positioning: Focused B2 preparation (~63 hours full / 55 hours minimum across 16 weeks), not a guarantee of a B2 result.
outcomes: Narrate past experiences, contrast habits, and handle real-life social interaction accurately
Understand 2–4 minute multi-accent listening tracks and 150–350 word articles at B2 pace
Deliver structured recorded speaking up to 3 minutes, culminating in B2 position statements
Plan, draft, and revise 120–220 word reports, articles, and essays with controlled error patterns
Consolidate B1 basics through the Grammar Clinic and finish with a personalised Week 16 error-log review

daily_flow.label: Vocabulary
daily_flow.description: Learn 8–10 new topic items with British English audio, collocations, and word families.

daily_flow.label: Grammar
daily_flow.description: Practise 1 main grammar point plus 1 light grammar point (Week 16 uses your personal error log).

daily_flow.label: Listening
daily_flow.description: Complete one 2–4 minute multi-accent audio track with comprehension questions (at least 1 of Wed/Thu required weekly; listening in ≥12/16 weeks).

daily_flow.label: Reading
daily_flow.description: Read one 150–350 word B1→B2 text with comprehension checks (at least 1 of Wed/Thu required weekly; reading in ≥12/16 weeks).

daily_flow.label: Speaking
daily_flow.description: Required recorded speaking task scaling from 60–90s to 3-minute B2 position statements, plus shadowing self-check.

daily_flow.label: Writing
daily_flow.description: Required 30-minute writing task scaling from 120–150 words to 200–220 words with structured error feedback.

daily_flow.label: Review
daily_flow.description: Review the week's spaced-repetition vocabulary cards and personal mistake log.

checkpoints.title: Checkpoint 1 · B1 Consolidation
checkpoints.description: Course checkpoint (not a CEFR placement or certification test): check control across Weeks 1–4 grammar (16 items), a 45–60s spoken narrative about a change, and a short written visitor note.
tasks: 16-item diagnostic across Weeks 1–4 (4 per week: past vs present perfect, future meanings, house-rule modals, present/past passives)
45–60s spoken narrative in response to a new prompt about a change (kept separate from quiz scoring)
Short written visitor note (100–140 words) separating a place fact from personal experience

checkpoints.title: Checkpoint 2 · Mid-Course Review
checkpoints.description: Verify B1+ to B2-entry control of deduction, reported speech, gerunds/infinitives, and third/mixed conditionals in a 2-minute talk and 150–180 word response.
tasks: 12-item grammar check on deduction, reporting verbs, gerunds/infinitives, and conditionals
2-minute recorded response weighing technology, work, media, or environmental choices
150–180 word structured opinion or report with clear paragraphing

checkpoints.title: Checkpoint 3 · B2 Readiness
checkpoints.description: Demonstrate B2 readiness through structured 3-minute speaking, a 180–200 word argument, and comprehension of 3-minute listening and 250–350 word reading.
tasks: 3-minute structured speaking task using causatives, articles/quantifiers, participle clauses, or emphasis
180–200 word analytical argument balancing competing viewpoints
Timed listening (3 min) and reading (250–350 words) comprehension verification

checkpoints.title: Checkpoint 4 · Final B2 Assessment
checkpoints.description: Full B2 readiness review: recorded position statement (up to 3 min), 200–220 word essay/proposal, personal error-log mastery check, and teacher readiness decision (Ready to start B2 exam preparation vs. named next step).
tasks: Recorded B2 position statement (up to 3 minutes) defending and qualifying a complex view
200–220 word formal argument or proposal using hedging, concession, and formal register
Mixed error-log consolidation check & teacher confirmation (Ready for B2 exam preparation or named next step)

badges.title: Week 1 Output
badges.description: Completed your first required output session in the 16-week pathway.

badges.title: 50 Active Words
badges.description: Learned and reviewed 50 B1→B2 core vocabulary items.

badges.title: Core Lexicon Builder
badges.description: Reviewed over 130 core B1→B2 vocabulary items across the 16 weeks.

badges.title: Voice Builder
badges.description: Submitted 8 Friday speaking recordings with self-check.

badges.title: Clear Writer
badges.description: Completed 8 Saturday writing tasks with revision.

badges.title: 16-Week Finisher
badges.description: Completed Checkpoint 4 at the end of Week 16.
